_transcription: ENGLISH half only, CBSE Class 10 Science (086), Series Z1XYW/5 SET-1. 27 page images: idx 0 cover, idx 1 Hindi instructions, idx 2 English instructions + Q1-2; English on EVERY EVEN index 2-26, Hindi on every odd index 3-25 (each the Hindi of the page after it). Odd-page tops checked: all Hindi, including idx 17 (Hindi Q32(a)(ii) continuation) and idx 23 (Hindi Q37 continuation); the last page idx 26 is English (Q39). Questions run 1-39 unbroken. Printed instructions confirm sci80: 39 questions, A Q1-20 x1 (Q17-20 Assertion-Reason), B 21-26 x2, C 27-33 x3, D 34-36 x5, E 37-39 x4. Instruction (viii) prints NO count of internal choices, so the roster was built by walking the marking scheme (ms idx 2-9) for a bare OR: Q21, 23, 30, 32, 34, 35, 37(c), 38(c), 39(c) = 9 alternatives, each confirmed against a printed OR on the paper. The case-study alternatives are printed '(c) OR (c)' (both labelled (c)), so refs Q37ci/Q37cii with questionNumber '37 (c)' / '37 (c) OR', following 2024 31/2/1. All 20 Section-A answers are CBSE's own, read off the scheme page image (ms idx 2); each re-derived, 20 of 20 agree. No void, grace note or dual key anywhere in the scheme. Decimal points on this paper are RAISED (Q28: 5{\cdot}5; Q39: 2{\cdot}5 D, 0{\cdot}1 D; the Q36 graph ticks too). Opener of series 31/5 for 2023: no 2023 Science file existed to compare against, nothing skipped.

questions.subtopic: Lens Formula and Power of a Lens
questions.context:
Many optical instruments consist of a number of lenses. They are combined to increase the magnification and sharpness of the image. The net power (P) of the lenses placed in contact is given by the algebraic sum of the powers of the individual lenses \(\mathrm{P_1, P_2, P_3 \ldots}\) as

\(\mathrm{P = P_1 + P_2 + P_3 \ldots}\)

This is also termed as the simple additive property of the power of lens, widely used to design lens systems of cameras, microscopes and telescopes. These lens systems can have a combination of convex lenses and also concave lenses.
questions.stem: What is the nature (convergent / divergent) of the combination of a convex lens of power \(+4\) D and a concave lens of power \(-2\) D ?
